document.about: Lutron Maestro LED+ dimmer submittal sheet. Page 5 sets three wiring diagrams in one drawn box, their labels in its margins, with a note in the column beside the box and the diagrams' title over it.

notes: #201: the figure regions started at the switch drawings, not the box, so labels in the box's margin were body text, and the note beside the box and the title over it were taken as the diagrams' labels.

checks.issue: `4-Way Wiring (Using MA-R Companion Dimmer)`, the title over the box, was a Figure.
`Note: Dimmer can be installed on the`, in the column beside the box, was a Figure.

element.text: Note: Dimmer can be installed on the

checks.issue: `Dimmer Line Side`, a label in the box's margin, was a Paragraph.
